svg.title: Shared VXLAN header and per-copy rewriting
svg.desc: A VNI 100 inner frame carries a REWRITE command with HEADER_READY, inner length, and flow hash. Devmap broadcasts it to two tunnel outputs and an access output. Each tunnel reconstructs the cache key, retrieves the common header and its own peer, and fills Outer addresses and a flow-derived UDP source port. The access output keeps the original Inner frame.
